justification: Removes the last hardcoded SEPP regulatory fallback (450 m2 / R1-R4) from the paid conveyancing PDF (#684, same defect class as the land-tax fallback removed in #681). Touches figure rendering in a legal document plus confidence rating, so above minor; no new data source, query, or external boundary, so below critical.

pre_impl.existing_data: housing_sepp_standards (migration 045) exists in production and returns a min_lot_size row with numeric_value and applicable_zones for secondary_dwelling, which is why the fallback only ever fired on DB-unreachable, not on every report. The land-tax removal in #681 established the exact fail-visible pattern being reused: absent config renders 'Not assessed' and caps confidence.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Test runs exposed a second consumer of the zone set the issue did not mention: the CDC eligibility section (~line 789) shares _SD_ZONES and its else-branch carried a hardcoded 'R1-R4' zone claim. Both now render from injected config or 'Not assessed'. Two fallback-era tests (test_regulatory_constants, test_conveyancing_forensic) asserted the old behaviour and were updated to the new contract rather than deleted.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new capability: same feasibility rows, same config loader, same confidence function. The change deletes the _SD_FALLBACK_MIN_LOT / _SD_FALLBACK_ZONES constants and the loader's 450 / R1-R4 defaults, adds the two 'Not assessed' branches, and extends the existing static-claims guard and confidence caps that the land-tax removal introduced.

functions.name: calc_feasibility
functions.input: controls dict, valuation dict, overlays list, is_strata flag, optional sepp_standards and tax_config dicts loaded from the DB
functions.output: list of feasibility row dicts with question, answer, flag, basis strings rendered into the PDF
functions.if_none: sepp_standards None or missing either key renders the secondary-dwelling and CDC rows 'Not assessed' with flag warn and no numeric figure, never a hardcoded 450 or R1-R4 claim

functions.name: load_regulatory_configs
functions.input: database URL string or None when DATABASE_URL is not set in the environment
functions.output: tuple of sepp_standards dict and tax_config dict, either element None when its rows are missing or unusable
functions.if_none: a missing, figure-less, or zone-less min_lot_size row now yields sepp_standards None with a logged warning instead of substituting 450 and the R1-R4 zone set

functions.name: _validate_sepp_sd_config
functions.input: the min_lot_size row dict from housing_sepp_standards, or None when no row was found
functions.output: validated sepp_standards dict with finite positive sd_min_lot and non-empty string zone set
functions.if_none: a zero, negative, NaN, or non-numeric minimum, or any null or empty zone entry, returns None so a corrupt row fails closed to 'Not assessed' instead of passing every lot or crashing sorted() mid-render (Sol review finding)

functions.name: _compute_confidence
functions.input: controls, overlays, valuation plus flags including new sepp_config_missing boolean from the API runner
functions.output: confidence rating string high, medium, or low printed on the report cover
functions.if_none: sepp_config_missing True caps the rating at medium so a report with an unassessed secondary-dwelling row cannot claim high confidence

values.value: min_lot_size row numeric_value and applicable_zones from housing_sepp_standards for secondary_dwelling
values.read_at: scripts/conveyancing_db.py load_regulatory_configs, guarded for presence of both fields before building the config dict
values.if_missing: sepp_standards stays None, warning logged, downstream rows render 'Not assessed', confidence capped at medium

queries: N/A - no query text changed; fetch_sepp_housing_standards call and its development_type filter are untouched, only the handling of an empty or incomplete result set changed.

break_it.scenario: DB unreachable at generation time, which previously made the report silently render the hardcoded 450 m2 / R1-R4 eligibility as if it were current law.
break_it.what_happens: Report used to state a regulatory figure nobody had verified; a stale SEPP amendment would render wrong eligibility in a paid legal document.
break_it.how: Constants deleted; the row renders 'Not assessed' with a basis directing the reader to the SEPP, main() prints a warning, and confidence caps at medium. test_config_absent_renders_not_assessed_no_figures asserts no digit-m2 pattern appears.
break_it.repro: Run generate_conveyancing_report.py with DATABASE_URL unset and read the secondary-dwelling row.

break_it.scenario: A half-loaded config, for example a min_lot_size row whose applicable_zones column is NULL, mixes a real figure with a defaulted zone set.
break_it.what_happens: Eligibility verdict would combine one authoritative value with one invented value, indistinguishable from a fully sourced verdict.
break_it.how: Loader requires both numeric_value and applicable_zones before building the dict, else None; calc_feasibility independently treats a dict missing either key as absent. test_partial_config_fails_visible_not_partial_figures covers dict-level halves; the loader guard covers row-level halves.
break_it.repro: Call calc_feasibility with sepp_standards={'sd_min_lot': 450.0} and observe 'Not assessed'.

break_it.scenario: Someone reintroduces the fallback later, for example during a refactor that 'restores' the deleted constants for convenience.
break_it.what_happens: The silent-hardcoded-figure defect returns without any test noticing, since ordinary golden tests inject config and would still pass.
break_it.how: TestStaticClaimsGuard bans _SD_FALLBACK, literal '450 m2' text, and the R1-R4 set literal from generator source; test_db_loader_contains_no_fallback_constants does the same for conveyancing_db.py; the mutation-style test injects a 600 m2 figure and asserts 450 never renders.
break_it.repro: Re-add _SD_FALLBACK_MIN_LOT = 450 to the generator and run tests/test_conveyancing_truth.py.

break_it.scenario: The CDC section, which shares the zone set, keeps its own hardcoded 'R1-R4' claim after the secondary-dwelling row is fixed.
break_it.what_happens: The same defect survives one section lower: a zone-eligibility claim renders with no data source behind it.
break_it.how: CDC section now renders 'Not assessed' when the zone set is absent and interpolates the injected zone list into the not-applicable branch instead of the literal R1-R4 string.
break_it.repro: Call calc_feasibility with sepp_standards=None for a B2 zone property and read the CDC row.

post_merge.db_reset: Not required - no schema or data changes; reads the existing housing_sepp_standards table exactly as before.
post_merge.secrets: No secrets involved - DATABASE_URL usage unchanged.
post_merge.other_repo: None. Follow-up filed for services/granny_flat.py which still carries _SEPP_FALLBACK_MIN_LOT_M2 = 450.0, the same defect class in the satellite product, kept out of this diff for reviewability.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - generate a report with DATABASE_URL unset: secondary-dwelling and CDC rows read 'Not assessed', cover confidence is at most medium, and no 450 m2 figure appears anywhere in the feasibility section.
